data_fields.name: pvp_optin_stat_gap
data_fields.donor_constant: 10 (max stat gap for ATTACK, DEFENSE, STRENGTH; hits not checked)

data_fields.name: pvp_depth_band
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: depth = 1 + wild/6 when wild > 0 else 0; level gap must be <= depth of attacker AND victim

data_fields.name: pvp_mutual_optin
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: pk_mode non-zero on both fighters

data_fields.name: duel_exempt
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: active mutual duel returns true before band and cooldown

best_idea: One server-side engage check that returns a reason, combining a mutual opt-in flag, a two-sided level-gap band that scales with zone danger depth, a reattack cooldown and a duel exemption.
decision_why: Gate shape fits our open PvP flag and server-verified engage; band comes from zone data and both donor modes merge into one function, the position formula and donor constants are not taken as they are.
acceptance: Two open-PvP fighters with level gap 7 in a zone with band 6 are refused by the server with reason 'level gap 7 > band 6' shown in the HUD, and engage once the band is 8; a server test asserts both refusals and that an active mutual duel ignores the band.
